name: smwmusic-mario-kart-super-circuit-boo-lake-broken-pier
title: Mario Kart: Super Circuit - Boo Lake / Broken Pier
description:
This is the spooky sounding music that plays on 2 of the courses in Mario Kart: Super Circuit. It's a bit more upbeat than most haunted songs. Fitting for a ghost house level or a spooky night level.

EDITS: Lowered master volume (239 → 232). Added an extreme vibrato fade to one of the channels.
